## Events

| Event                    | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | Type                                          |
| ------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `pdsComboboxChange`      | Emitted when the user picks an option, with a click or with `Enter` on the highlighted option (or `Space`, on the `button` and `chip` triggers), even the option already selected. `detail` has `value`, the option's `value` as a string. `clear()` emits it too, with an empty `value`, when something was selected or typed. Typing in the field only filters the list and doesn't emit it.  This event will not emit when programmatically setting the `value` property. | `CustomEvent<{ value: string; }>`             |
| `pdsComboboxLoadOptions` | Emitted with `async-url` when the list is scrolled near its end and the response's `totalCount` says more options remain, as the combobox fetches the next page itself. `detail` has `query` and `page`, the page being fetched. It can be emitted more than once for the same page while that page waits to load, and never without `async-url`.                                                                                                                            | `CustomEvent<ComboboxLoadOptionsEventDetail>` |
| `pdsComboboxSearch`      | Emitted when the search text changes, in the `input` trigger or in the `panel-search` field, once `debounce` milliseconds (300 by default) have passed since the last change. `detail` has `query`, the text as typed. With `panel-search`, it's also emitted with an empty `query` when the dropdown closes with text in the search field, which is cleared. Use it to load `options` yourself; with `async-url`, the combobox fetches on its own.                          | `CustomEvent<ComboboxSearchEventDetail>`      |


## Methods

### `clear() => Promise<void>`

Clears the selected value and resets the component. Works while disabled too, as setting a
native control's value from script does. Emits `pdsComboboxChange` with an empty `value` when
something was selected or typed.

#### Returns

Type: `Promise<void>`



### `getSelectedValue() => Promise<string | null>`

Returns the `value` of the selected option, or `null` when none is selected.

#### Returns

Type: `Promise<string>`



### `setFocus() => Promise<void>`

Sets focus on the trigger: the native `input`, or the `button` or `chip` trigger.

#### Returns

Type: `Promise<void>`




## Slots

| Slot                | Description                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `"(default)"`       | The options: `<option>` and `<optgroup>` elements, and `<pds-text>` group headings. Other elements are ignored, and so are all of them while `options` or `async-url` is set. |
| `"empty"`           | Custom empty state message when no options match                                                                                                                              |
| `"loading"`         | Custom loading indicator                                                                                                                                                      |
| `"trigger-content"` | Custom content for the button trigger when customTriggerContent is true                                                                                                       |


## Shadow Parts

| Part               | Description                                                                                          |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `"button-trigger"` | Exposes the button trigger for styling. Appears only when `trigger` is `button`.                     |
| `"chip-trigger"`   | Exposes the chip trigger for styling. Appears only when `trigger` is `chip`.                         |
| `"combobox"`       | Exposes the outer container around the label, trigger and messages for styling.                      |
| `"input"`          | Exposes the native `input` element for styling. Appears only when `trigger` is `input`, the default. |
